evidence_scope: Synthetic media and metrics; real Pyodide/SQLite runtime in isolated Chrome at 390px, tested under a URL subpath. Not physical Safari or iPhone testing.
network_contract: Static same-origin GET requests only, no data-server API, relay, pairing or video upload.
limits: Automatic transcription and learned semantic models are not in this phone edition.
Cross-device exchange uses explicit JSON files, not automatic sync.
Browser storage can be cleared or evicted; export important work.
Actual iPhone installation and representative large-corpus throughput remain unverified.
